record.field: Public link pages and signature QR codes.

Maintains their own link page and downloads its QR code. Sees other people's pages without being able to edit them: a page is public anyway, hiding it in the back office would protect nothing and would prevent spotting a duplicate slug.

Maintains templates, creates one-off pages and edits anyone's page. Templates are reserved to this group: they are assigned by user group, so editing them amounts to changing several people's pages at once.
